problemSigns.detail: The motor runs, but the door does not move up or down. This often indicates a stripped gear or a broken drive mechanism inside the opener unit.
The garage door starts to close but then reverses before it touches the ground. This usually points to an issue with the safety sensors or their alignment.
Your remote control or wall-mounted keypad fails to activate the garage door. This can be a problem with the opener's logic board or the remote's signal.
The small lights on your safety sensors near the bottom of the garage door track are blinking. This signals an obstruction or a misalignment preventing closure.
The trolley carriage moves along the rail, but the garage door itself remains in the closed position. This indicates a disengaged or broken trolley.
